definition_one_sentence: A customer account with at least one non-cancelled order in the 12 months ending on the report date.
formula_or_rule: Exists an order for the customer where status != cancelled and order_date is within the trailing 12 months.
example: As of 2026-11-25, an account with a shipped order on 2026-06-01 is active; an account with only cancelled orders is not.
notes_conflicts: Memo differences: Sales wants a daily, seasonal-campaign measure for someone who bought in 6 months and leaves cancellation/account scope unstated; Finance wants an account with a non-cancelled order in 12 months for board, annual-account and investor comparison. Role-play: Sara keeps a clearly labelled 6-month campaign view; Paul states Finance's requirement; Steward records and tests both; Owner (CFO/Head of Finance) chooses 12 months for the company KPI. Simulation only; obtain real sign-off before production.

definition_one_sentence: Revenue after refunds, excluding VAT and retaining shipping fees.
formula_or_rule: (gross_revenue_eur - refunded_eur) / 1.20 when both are EUR and the applicable VAT rate is 20%; otherwise remove the applicable VAT rate after refunds.
example: EUR 120 gross including EUR 20 VAT and shipping, less an EUR 12 refund including VAT: (120 - 12) / 1.20 = EUR 90.
related_columns: fct_orders.gross_revenue_eur, refunded_eur, net_revenue_eur; stg_payments.amount, currency, payment_status
notes_conflicts: Sales defines net as customer-paid less refunds with VAT included and does not specify shipping; Finance requires refunds deducted, VAT excluded, shipping retained. Role-play adopts Finance's rule for company reporting; Sales may show a separately labelled VAT-inclusive gross-sales view. Source inventory says payment amount is EUR?; confirm provider units before implementation. Simulation only; obtain real sign-off before production.

definition_one_sentence: A customer account with a prior non-cancelled order but no non-cancelled order in the trailing 12 months.
formula_or_rule: Has at least one historical non-cancelled order and no non-cancelled order between the report date minus 12 months and the report date.
example: An account whose last non-cancelled order was on 2024-10-01 is churned as of 2026-11-25, unless it has ordered again.
notes_conflicts: Use the company active-customer window and cancellation rule for consistency. Role-play simulation only; confirm real sign-off before production.

definition_one_sentence: A customer is one ShopFast account identified by customer_id, not necessarily one unique person.
formula_or_rule: One customer record per customer_id; count distinct customer_id for account-level metrics.
example: One account with three orders is one customer; two account IDs belonging to one person are two accounts.
notes_conflicts: The Finance memo explicitly defines activity at account level; the Sales memo says someone. This glossary standardizes the account grain. Role-play simulation only; confirm real sign-off before production.

definition_one_sentence: An order is one ShopFast order header identified by order_id, regardless of its number of items or payment events.
formula_or_rule: One row per distinct order_id after exact duplicate order headers are removed.
example: Order 700002 remains one order even if it has several item lines or a refund event.
notes_conflicts: Use the order-header grain for company metrics. Role-play simulation only; confirm real sign-off before production.
